# google_places_sdk_flutter

> Address autocomplete for Flutter on Google Places API (New). A text field (or a dialog/fullscreen
> search) that returns the picked place's coordinates and parsed address, plus a typed client for
> Place Details, Text Search, Nearby Search, Place Photos, and Time Zone. Pure Dart, no plugin, all
> six Flutter platforms including Wasm. New-API only: there is no legacy Places API support.

## Install

```shell
flutter pub add google_places_sdk_flutter
```

Requires Flutter >=3.44.0, Dart >=3.12.0. Enable "Places API (New)" (and, for web, "Maps
JavaScript API") on a Google Cloud project with billing. Do not add `material_ui` to an app just
for this package — it is this package's own dependency — unless the app passes `decoration:`. Import only:

```dart
import 'package:google_places_sdk_flutter/google_places_sdk_flutter.dart';
```

## Smallest working code

```dart
// A field on the page:
PlacesAutocompleteField(
  apiKey: const String.fromEnvironment('GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY'),
  onSelection: (PlaceSelection selection) {
    final place = selection.place; // filled in by default
    debugPrint('${place?.location} ${place?.formattedAddress}');
  },
)

// Or an awaitable picker:
final PlaceSelection? selection = await PlacesAutocompleteOverlay.show(
  context,
  apiKey: const String.fromEnvironment('GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY'),
  mode: PlacesAutocompleteOverlayMode.dialog, // or .fullscreen
);
```

Run with `flutter run --dart-define=GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=...`.

## Widgets

- `PlacesAutocompleteField` — inline field; `fieldMode:` `inline` (default), `dialog`, `fullscreen`.
- `PlacesAutocompleteFormField` — the same inside a `Form`; standard `validator`, `onSaved`,
  `initialValue`, `autovalidateMode`, `forceErrorText`, `errorBuilder`, `restorationId`. To start
  from a saved place: store its place ID, then
  `initialValue: PlaceSelection.fromPlace(await client.fetchPlaceById(savedId))`.
- `PlacesAutocompleteOverlay.show(context, ...)` → `Future<PlaceSelection?>`; `null` if dismissed.
- `PlacesPhotoAttribution(photo: photo)` — required author attribution next to a photo.

All four autocomplete surfaces (field, form field, overlay widget, `show()`) take **exactly one** of `apiKey:` (widget owns, replaces, and
closes its client) or `client:` (caller owns a `PlacesClient`). Use `client:` to share a client,
for `PlacesClient.proxy(...)`, or for an Android/iOS app-restricted key, which needs
`PlacesClientOptions(applicationIdentity: PlacesApplicationIdentity.android(pkg, sha1))` or
`.ios(bundleId)` — a client made from `apiKey:` sends no identity.

Common options (same names on all surfaces): `languageCode`, `regionCode`, `origin`
(`PlaceCoordinates`, makes Google return straight-line distances), `locationBias` /
`locationRestriction` (mutually exclusive), `includedPrimaryTypes` (e.g. `['restaurant']`,
`['(cities)']`), `includedRegionCodes`, `includeQueryPredictions` + `onQuerySelection`,
`fetchPlaceDetailsOnSelection` (default `true`), `selectionFields` (default
`PlaceFieldPresets.address`), `fetchTimeZoneOnSelection` (default `false`), `maxSuggestions`
(max 5), `decoration` (`material_ui`'s `InputDecoration`), `strings` (`PlacesStrings`),
`fieldBuilder` / `suggestionItemBuilder` / `suggestionsViewBuilder` (below), `onError`,
`onClearField`, `enabled`, `showPoweredByGoogle`, `includeFutureOpeningBusinesses`,
`minInputLength` (default 1; no billed request below it), `debounceDuration` (`null` uses the
controller's, 300 ms), `autofocus` (field widgets only), `controller`
(`PlacesAutocompleteController`: text, focus, session, selection, `debounceDuration`).
Inline field widgets only: `unfocusOnSelection` (default `true`), `suggestionsViewOpenDirection`
(`OptionsViewOpenDirection.mostSpace` / `.down` / `.up`).

`TextField` options, passed to the default field on every surface: `keyboardType` (default
`TextInputType.streetAddress`), `textInputAction`, `textCapitalization`, `style`, `textAlign`,
`textDirection`, `autocorrect`, `enableSuggestions`, `enableIMEPersonalizedLearning`,
`inputFormatters`, `maxLength`, `maxLengthEnforcement`, `autofillHints`, `keyboardAppearance`,
`scrollPadding`, `onSubmitted`, `onEditingComplete`.

Widget text: `strings: const PlacesStrings(searchHint: ..., loadingText: ..., noResultsText: ...,
errorText: ..., retryText: ..., poweredByGoogleLabel: ..., overlayTitle: ..., closeLabel: ...,
clearLabel: ..., placeSuggestionLabel: ..., querySuggestionLabel: ..., distanceUnitMeters: ...)`.
Every default is English and the package does not pick strings from the app's locale yet, so a
non-English app passes them all. `languageCode` sets Google's result language, not the widget's
text. `PlacesPhotoAttribution`'s "Photo by" is its own `prefix:` parameter.

Builders — each gets one data object and reaches every mode:

```dart
suggestionItemBuilder: (context, PlacesSuggestionItemData item) => switch (item.suggestion) {
  final PlaceSuggestion place => ListTile(title: Text(place.primaryText.text), onTap: item.onSelected),
  final QuerySuggestion query => ListTile(title: Text(query.displayText), onTap: item.onSelected),
}, // item.highlighted: keyboard highlight
suggestionsViewBuilder: (context, PlacesSuggestionsViewData view) => switch (view.status) {
  PlacesSuggestionsStatus.error => Card(child: ListTile(title: Text('Failed: ${view.error?.kind.name}'), onTap: view.onRetry)),
  _ => view.defaultView, // loading, results, empty: the package's own
}, // also view.items (built rows — use them), view.attribution, view.suggestions
fieldBuilder: (context, PlacesFieldData field) => CupertinoSearchTextField(
  controller: field.controller, focusNode: field.focusNode,
  onChanged: field.onChanged, // required: starts the search
  onTap: field.onTap, onSuffixTap: field.onClear ?? () {}, enabled: field.enabled,
), // also field.readOnly, autofocus, selectionLoading (no progress bar drawn), errorText, strings
```

A `Theme` around the field with `listTileTheme` set restyles the default rows without a builder, in
every mode (a `ListTileTheme` widget only reaches inline mode). `suggestionBuilder`
(title only) is deprecated — use `suggestionItemBuilder`; the two cannot be combined. A legacy
`package:flutter/material.dart` `TextField` returned from `fieldBuilder` needs a `Material` from that
library around it in dialog and fullscreen modes.

Areas:

```dart
locationBias: LocationBias.circle(center: const PlaceCoordinates(latitude: 51.5, longitude: -0.12), radiusMeters: 20000),
locationRestriction: LocationRestriction.rectangle(low: southWest, high: northEast),
```

Radius at most 50000 m. Shapes accepted: autocomplete (widgets, `autocomplete()`) — both, except
through Maps JavaScript (the web default), where `locationRestriction` must be a rectangle; `TextSearchRequest.locationRestriction` —
rectangle only; `NearbySearchRequest.locationRestriction` — circle only, required.

## What a selection carries

`PlaceSelection`: `placeId`, `displayText`, `suggestion` (`PlaceSuggestion`: `primaryText`,
`secondaryText`, `distanceMeters`), `place` (`PlaceData?`), `timeZone`, `sessionToken`.

`PlaceData` address getters: `streetAddress`, `streetNumber`, `route`, `unit`, `neighborhood`,
`city` (falls back `locality` → `postal_town` → `sublocality_level_1` →
`administrative_area_level_3`), `locality`, `county`, `administrativeArea`, `postalCode`,
`postalCodeSuffix`, `country`, `countryShort` (ISO code); most have a `...Short` variant. Also `location`,
`formattedAddress`, `shortFormattedAddress`, `addressComponents` (`List<PlaceAddressComponent>`:
`longText`, `shortText`, `types` — read it for formats the getters do not fit). `postalAddress`
(`PlacePostalAddress`) needs `PlaceField.postalAddress`, which is not in the default.

Time zone, two ways: `PlaceField.timeZone` → `place.timeZone?.id` (`PlaceTimeZone`, IANA id) and
`PlaceField.utcOffsetMinutes` → `place.utcOffsetMinutes` (current offset), both Pro; or
`fetchTimeZoneOnSelection: true` → `selection.timeZone` (`PlaceTimeZoneData`: `timeZoneId`,
`timeZoneName`, `rawOffset`, `dstOffset`, `timestamp`), from the separately billed Time Zone API,
at `selectionTimeZoneAt` (default now).

## Field presets and billing

- `PlaceFieldPresets.address` — default for widget `selectionFields`, `PlaceDetailsRequest`, and
  `fetchPlaceById`: `id`, `formattedAddress`, `shortFormattedAddress`, `location`,
  `addressComponents` — all Place Details **Essentials**.
- `PlaceFieldPresets.minimal` — default for `TextSearchRequest` and `NearbySearchRequest`: `id`,
  `displayName`, `formattedAddress`, `location` — **Pro**.
- `.recommended` adds `rating` (Enterprise) but has no `addressComponents`, so `city` and the
  other parsed getters are `null`; `.rich` adds `reviews` (Enterprise + Atmosphere). To add fields,
  spread `address` into a larger set.
  Google bills a request at its highest-tier field. Passing `fields:` overrides any default.
- `PlaceField.timeZone` and `utcOffsetMinutes` are Pro. `fetchTimeZoneOnSelection: true` instead
  calls the separately billed Time Zone API.
- A details request above Essentials that ends an autocomplete session (the widgets' does) is billed
  at Enterprise + Atmosphere.
- `displayName` is not in the default; the picked name is `selection.suggestion.primaryText.text`.
- Photos are not in the default: add `PlaceField.photos` to `selectionFields`, or
  `place.photos` is empty. Each `client.fetchPhotoMedia` call is billed separately.
- The widgets manage autocomplete session tokens and end the session with the details request.

## Client

```dart
final client = PlacesClient(apiKey: key); // close() when done
final suggestions = await client.autocomplete(AutocompleteRequest(input: 'cof', sessionToken: token));
final place = await client.fetchPlace(PlaceDetailsRequest(placeId: id, sessionToken: token)); // address fields
final results = await client.searchText(const TextSearchRequest(textQuery: 'coffee', pageSize: 10)); // minimal fields
final page = await client.searchTextPage(...); // nextPageToken
final nearby = await client.searchNearby(NearbySearchRequest(...));
final media = await client.fetchPhotoMedia(PhotoMediaRequest(...));
final zone = await client.fetchTimeZoneForPlace(place);
```

Every operation takes an optional `cancellationToken: PlacesCancellationToken()`. Failures are
`PlacesException` with `kind` (`PlacesErrorKind`), `statusCode`, `code` (Google's status, e.g.
`PERMISSION_DENIED`), `retryable`, `message`. `PlacesErrorKind` values: `validation` (never sent),
`configuration`, `network`, `timeout`, `cancellation`, `http`, `googleApi`, `proxy`, `javascript`
(web), `unknown`.

`PlacesClient.proxy(placesEndpoint: ..., authentication: (PlacesProxyRequest request) async =>
{'Authorization': ...})` — the callback runs before every proxy request and receives
`operation`, `method`, and `uri` (do not log the URI). It may not return `Content-Type`,
`Content-Length`, `Host`, `X-Goog-Api-Key`, `X-Goog-FieldMask`, or `X-Goog-User-Project`.

## Apps not yet on material_ui

Apps still on `package:flutter/material.dart` need no extra code; the widgets use `material_ui`'s
default theme there. A `decoration:` must still be `material_ui`'s `InputDecoration`
(`import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart' as mui;`).

## Mistakes to avoid

- Passing both `apiKey:` and `client:`, or neither — a debug assertion fails.
- Reading `place.displayName`, `rating`, or `photos` without requesting them — they are `null` or
  empty. Add them to `selectionFields` / `fields`.
- Using `apiKey:` with an Android- or iOS-restricted key — Google rejects it; pass a `client:` with
  `applicationIdentity`.
- Building `decoration:` from `package:flutter/material.dart`'s `InputDecoration` — it must be
  `material_ui`'s.
- A `fieldBuilder` field that never calls `field.onChanged` — nothing is searched.
- Expecting `keyboardType`, `inputFormatters` or the other `TextField` options to reach a
  `fieldBuilder` field — they configure the default field only; set them on your own.
- Building rows inside `suggestionsViewBuilder` instead of using `view.items` — keyboard
  highlighting then cannot keep the highlighted row in view.
- Passing `LocationRestriction.circle(...)` to autocomplete through Maps JavaScript (web), or to
  `TextSearchRequest` — it fails with a `validation` error; use `.rectangle(...)`. Setting both
  `locationBias` and `locationRestriction` fails validation.
- Enabling the legacy "Places API" instead of "Places API (New)" — requests fail with
  `PERMISSION_DENIED`.
